cd /workspace && python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'dev')
import ref
from itertools import product
doc = json.load(open('examples/endpoint-cycle.input.json'))
ixps=set(doc['ixps'])
agg={}
for rec in doc['rib']:
    p,looped=ref.normalize(rec['path'], ixps)
    if looped or len(p)<2: continue
    agg[p]=agg.get(p,0)+rec['count']
print("agg", agg)
rounds, finals = ref.peel(agg)
print("rounds", rounds, "finals", finals)
core=sorted(set(agg and [ref.canon(p[i],p[i+1]) for p in finals for i in range(len(p)-1)]))
print("core", core)
occ=ref.occurrences(finals, core)
for o in occ: print("occ", o)
# enumerate
Z=0
for states in product(range(3), repeat=3):
    X=dict(zip(range(3), states))
    w=1
    phis=[]
    for e in range(3):
        phis.append(ref.phi_value(e, occ, core, X))
    w=1
    for p in phis: w*=p
    print(states, phis, w)
    Z+=w
print("Z", Z)
EOF
